recommendation_question: Should HSConfig expand its normal pre-run runtime surface now, given documented VisionAI CardID behavior blocks, Combo exactness, GlobalValues authority, option identity requirements, and the risk of bloating the skill beyond its pre-run purpose?
evidence_sources: Focused verification on 2026-07-08: python -m pytest C:/Users/darbo/Documents/HSConfig/tests/test_surface_intent.py C:/Users/darbo/Documents/HSConfig/tests/test_card_behavior_router.py C:/Users/darbo/Documents/HSConfig/tests/test_compile_combo.py C:/Users/darbo/Documents/HSConfig/tests/test_compile_globalvalues.py C:/Users/darbo/Documents/HSConfig/tests/test_apply_gate.py -q -> 55 passed in 0.63s
current_state: HSConfig is already aligned to a narrow pre-run boundary. The normal path is explicitly pre-run only, with GlobalValues.json and Mulligan.json required for every package, one per-card CARDID.json surface for each contract card, and Combo.json only when exact ordered combo data exists. Card behavior lowering is documented-block only and fail-closed: unsupported blocks, unsupported conditions, and unresolved option ownership stay visible in reports instead of becoming guessed runtime JSON. GlobalValues authority is also intentionally narrow: baseline keys are copied and profiled, a small set of posture keys may be overlaid during Step 1, and runtime-evidence-required keys remain blocked for HSTuner or another post-run workflow. Option identity is still a real boundary: Discover and Choose One lowering depends on resolved owner or option CardIDs, and unresolved identities are suppressed as unresolved_option_identity. The representative eleven-deck matrix points to the same conclusion: the remaining gaps are source-depth closure and deeper lowering inside the allowed surfaces, not missing runtime file families.
highest_value_next_action: Do not expand the normal runtime surface now. Keep the current boundary and spend the next increment on higher-yield work inside it: improve documented-safe condition lowering, strengthen option identity resolution, and deepen claim-specific CardID lowering for existing blocked decks such as Kingslayer and Boarlock.
why_not_alternatives: Broadening the runtime surface now is lower value and riskier for four reasons. First, the current blockers are mostly inside the existing surfaces: exact combo evidence, unsupported condition lowering, and option identity resolution. Second, adding more normal-path surfaces would push HSConfig away from its stated pre-run purpose and blur the boundary with HSTuner. Third, GlobalValues already has high blast radius, so widening authority before finishing the current guardrails would increase the chance of speculative tuning. Fourth, validator and registry awareness is already broader than the approved normal path, so adding more emitted surfaces now would increase maintenance drift and make the operator contract harder to keep lean and clear.
implementation_shape: If a follow-up plan is requested, it should stay boundary-preserving and split into three small lanes. Lane 1: extend option identity resolution only for documented-safe ownership cases such as Discover source ownership, Choose One branch ownership, known hero-power transforms, and other deterministic linked entities. Lane 2: expand condition lowering only for documented grammar fragments that can be validated and tested fail-closed. Lane 3: improve claim-to-block routing depth and source-gap reporting inside existing CARDID.json, Combo.json, and GlobalValues.json behavior, while keeping Presume.json and Concede.json outside the normal path and keeping Combo.json exact-sequence only.
risks_and_guards: Keep these guards in place. Do not emit new normal-path runtime files such as Presume.json or Concede.json. Do not lower vague strategy text into runtime JSON. Do not treat registry-known or validator-supported surfaces as operator-approved output surfaces. Do not bypass exact option identity for Discover, Choose One, Adapt, upgrade, or transformed hero-power ownership. Do not let GlobalValues overlays expand beyond copy_baseline plus step1_posture_overlay_allowed without runtime evidence. Preserve fail-closed suppression, per-row provenance, strict JSON validation, GameCardId-to-filename agreement, and apply-gate blocking for non-normal surfaces.
success_criteria: This recommendation is successful if the next work leaves the normal output contract unchanged, reduces cards_needing_runtime_surface or related readiness blockers through better lowering inside the current surfaces, preserves exact-combo-only Combo.json emission, preserves GlobalValues authority categories, preserves unresolved option identity suppression where identity is still not provable, and keeps the focused runtime-surface verification slice green.
